description:
Title: Work Accident

Create a process that helps in gathering information about work accidents (and almost work accidents):
For insured gainful employment, a work accident is considered to be an accident that occurs in the following circumstances, by way of example:
* the accident occurs in a location, at a time and with a cause that correlates to the insured employment
* when working from home
* on the direct route from the permanent place of residence to work, to lunch or on the way home, whereby carpools are also protected
* for training sessions that serve to provide specific professional knowledge, whereby an accident on to way to or from the training centre is considered a work accident
* on the direct route from home, or from the workplace or training centre to a doctor and back, if this interrupts the direct route from the permanent place of residence to work or the route home (the doctor's visit must be notified to the employer in advance)
* on the way to or from the workplace or training centre with the purpose of taking a child to or collecting them from a childcare facility, a daycare facility, external care or a school, insofar as they have a supervisory responsibility for the child
* when making use of advocacy groups or professional associations (e.g. Chamber of Labour, trade union federation, guild etc.)

For kindergarten children, schoolchildren and students, an accident is considered to be a work accident if, amongst other things
* the accident occurs in a location, at a time and with a cause that correlates to the school or university education or the compulsory kindergarten year that forms the basis of the insurance
* when taking part in a school event or school-related event 
* on the direct route from the child's place of residence or permanent accommodation to kindergarten or a school visit or on the way home
* when performing a practical task prescribed as part of the curriculum and/or the study regulations or 
* in certain professional (training) orientations.

In an agricultural or forestry establishment, accidents can be considered work accidents if they do not occur directly while performing the insured employment.
Depending on the protected group of people, the following tasks are covered by accident insurance:
* working in the household of the owner of the company and/or the employee, if the household serves the company to a considerable extent
* working in connection with providing accommodation for guests 
* secondary occupations for the sale of agricultural products from the farm
* working in the context of erecting, converting and repairing buildings that serve the agricultural and forestry establishment
* working in the context of neighbourhood assistance for another agricultural and forestry establishment  

Certain accidents are considered the same as work accidents and in many cases can also affect people who do not have accident insurance.
Accidents that occur in one of the following situations, among others, are considered to be work accidents outside of professional activity:
* for activities with which services from the Unemployment Insurance Act / Labor Market Promotion Act are being made use of (e.g. on the way to an arranged job interview)
* when assisting with an accident or donating blood
* when receiving training, taking part in exercises or serving as a member of one of the following aid organisations:
    * Volunteer fire brigade
    * Volunteer water rescue service
    * Volunteer rescue organisations
    * Austrian Red Cross
    * Austrian Alpine Rescue Service
    * Austrian Water Rescue
    * Austrian Rescue Dog Brigade
    * Avalanche warning committees
    * Air rescue service
    * Radiation detection and survey crews

The employees must inform the employer immediately of:
* any work accident
* any incident that would almost have led to an accident
* any serious and immediate risk to safety and health that they discover
* any defect discovered in protection systems.

The employer must, in turn, immediately report any work accident that leads to a fatality or serious injury to the Labour Inspectorate, if it has not been reported to the emergency services.

Independent of this, every work accident in which a person with accident insurance has been killed, or injured in such a way that they are unable to work for three days, in full or in part, must be reported to the responsible accident insurance provider within five days.

As a self-employed person, please ensure that you not only report accidents involving people you employ but also those that involve you to the accident insurance provider in good time.

Students and schoolchildren should report accidents to the competent directorate.
Schools, educational facilities and universities are obliged to report every work accident through which a person with accident insurance is physically injured or killed within a maximum of five days to the responsible accident insurance provider in triplicate.

In the case of private insurance, the insured party must report an accident in writing immediately in line with the conditions and to avoid the provider from being released from the obligation to perform.
If there are fatalities, this must be reported within three days, even if the accident has already been reported.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_WorkAccident" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/work-accident">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_EmployerNotification" name="Employee incident notification"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AccidentInsuranceReport" name="Accident insurance report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_LabourInspectorateReport" name="Labour Inspectorate report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DirectorateReport" name="Student accident report"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PrivateInsuranceReport" name="Private insurance accident report"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_WorkAccident">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_ReportingProcess" name="Work Accident information and reporting" processRef="Process_WorkAccident"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_AccidentInsuranceProvider" name="Responsible accident insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_LabourInspectorate" name="Labour Inspectorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_CompetentDirectorate" name="Competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PrivateInsuranceProvider" name="Private insurance provider"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmployeeNotification" name="Notify employer immediately" sourceRef="Task_NotifyEmployer" targetRef="Participant_ReportingProcess" messageRef="Message_EmployerNotification"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_LabourInspectorate" name="Report fatal or serious work accident" sourceRef="Task_ReportLabourInspectorate" targetRef="Participant_LabourInspectorate" messageRef="Message_LabourInspectorateReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AccidentInsuranceGeneral" name="Report qualifying accident within five days" sourceRef="Task_ReportAccidentInsurance" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsuranceProvider" messageRef="Message_AccidentInsuranceReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AccidentInsuranceSelfEmployed" name="Report self-employed accident in good time" sourceRef="Task_ReportSelfEmployedAccident" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsuranceProvider" messageRef="Message_AccidentInsuranceReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AccidentInsuranceSchool" name="Report school accident within five days in triplicate" sourceRef="Task_ReportSchoolAccident" targetRef="Participant_AccidentInsuranceProvider" messageRef="Message_AccidentInsuranceReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Directorate" name="Report student accident" sourceRef="Task_StudentReport" targetRef="Participant_CompetentDirectorate" messageRef="Message_DirectorateReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrivateInsuranceImmediate" name="Report accident in writing immediately" sourceRef="Task_PrivateImmediateReport" targetRef="Participant_PrivateInsuranceProvider" messageRef="Message_PrivateInsuranceReport"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PrivateInsuranceFatal" name="Report fatal accident within three days" sourceRef="Task_PrivateFatalReport" targetRef="Participant_PrivateInsuranceProvider" messageRef="Message_PrivateInsuranceReport"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_WorkAccident" name="Work Accident" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Incident" name="Accident, near accident or hazard discovered"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherInformation" name="Gather incident information">
      <bpmn:documentation>Record the available information about the accident, almost accident, serious and immediate safety or health risk, or defect in a protection system.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssessContext" name="Assess accident context">
      <bpmn:documentation>For insured gainful employment, examples of work-accident circumstances include an accident at a place, time and with a cause correlated to the insured employment; working from home; the direct route between permanent residence and work, lunch or home, including carpools; professional training and the direct route to or from its centre; a notified-in-advance doctor's visit and the relevant route between home, workplace or training centre and doctor; travel to or from work or training to take a child for whom the person has supervisory responsibility to, or collect the child from, childcare, daycare, external care or school; and use of advocacy groups or professional associations such as the Chamber of Labour, trade union federation or guild.
For kindergarten children, schoolchildren and students, examples include an accident at a place, time and with a cause correlated to the insured school or university education or compulsory kindergarten year; participation in a school or school-related event; the direct route between the child's residence or permanent accommodation and kindergarten or school; a practical task prescribed by the curriculum or study regulations; and certain professional training orientations.
In agricultural or forestry establishments, covered accidents may also occur outside the direct performance of insured employment. Depending on the protected group, examples include work in the owner's or employee's household where it serves the establishment to a considerable extent; work providing guest accommodation; secondary occupations selling farm agricultural products; work erecting, converting or repairing buildings serving the establishment; and neighbourhood assistance for another agricultural or forestry establishment.
Accidents treated as equivalent to work accidents can also affect people without accident insurance. Examples outside professional activity include activities using services under the Unemployment Insurance Act or Labour Market Promotion Act, such as travelling to an arranged job interview; assisting at an accident or donating blood; and training, exercises or service as a member of a volunteer fire brigade, volunteer water rescue service, volunteer rescue organisation, Austrian Red Cross, Austrian Alpine Rescue Service, Austrian Water Rescue, Austrian Rescue Dog Brigade, avalanche warning committee, air rescue service, or radiation detection and survey crew. These are examples of circumstances, not an exhaustive list.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ApplicableDuties" name="Determine applicable reporting duties" gatewayDirection="Diverging" default="Flow_NoReportingDuty"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NotifyEmployer" name="Employee: notify employer immediately">
      <bpmn:documentation>Employees must immediately inform the employer of any work accident, incident that would almost have led to an accident, serious and immediate risk to safety and health that they discover, or defect they discover in protection systems.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportLabourInspectorate" name="Employer: report fatal or serious work accident to Labour Inspectorate">
      <bpmn:documentation>The employer must immediately report a work accident leading to a fatality or serious injury to the Labour Inspectorate if it has not been reported to the emergency services.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportAccidentInsurance" name="Report qualifying insured-person accident within five days">
      <bpmn:documentation>Every work accident in which a person with accident insurance is killed or injured so that they are unable to work, fully or partly, for three days must be reported to the responsible accident insurance provider within five days.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportSelfEmployedAccident" name="Self-employed person: report accident to accident insurance provider in good time">
      <bpmn:documentation>A self-employed person should report accidents involving people they employ and accidents involving themselves to the accident insurance provider in good time.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_StudentReport" name="Student or schoolchild: report accident to competent directorate"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReportSchoolAccident" name="School or educational institution: report insured person's physical injury or death within five days">
      <bpmn:documentation>Schools, educational facilities and universities must report every work accident through which a person with accident insurance is physically injured or killed to the responsible accident insurance provider within a maximum of five days, in triplicate.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PrivateImmediateReport" name="Privately insured person: report accident in writing immediately">
      <bpmn:documentation>In the case of private insurance, the insured party must report an accident in writing immediately in line with the policy conditions, to avoid release of the provider from its obligation to perform.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PrivateFatal" name="Was there a fatality?" gatewayDirection="Diverging" default="Flow_PrivateNotFatal"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PrivateFatalReport" name="Privately insured person: report fatality within three days">
      <bpmn:documentation>A fatality must be reported within three days even if the accident has already been reported.</bpmn:documentation>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_NoAdditionalReport" name="No listed reporting duty applies"/>
    <bpmn:inclusiveGateway id="Gateway_JoinDuties" name="Join applicable reporting duties" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Complete" name="Information gathered and applicable reports made"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Gather" sourceRef="StartEvent_Incident" targetRef="Task_GatherInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Gather_Assess" sourceRef="Task_GatherInformation" targetRef="Task_AssessContext"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assess_Duties" sourceRef="Task_AssessContext" targetRef="Gateway_ApplicableDuties"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Duties_Employee" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicableDuties" targetRef="Task_NotifyEmployer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">employee and (work accident or almost accident or discovered serious immediate safety or health risk or discovered protection-system defect)</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Duties_Labour" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicableDuties" targetRef="Task_ReportLabourInspectorate">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">employer and work accident and (fatality or serious injury) and not reported to emergency services</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Duties_Insurance" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicableDuties" targetRef="Task_ReportAccidentInsurance">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">work accident and insured person killed or unable to work for at least three days, fully or partly</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Duties_SelfEmployed" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicableDuties" targetRef="Task_ReportSelfEmployedAccident">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">self-employed person and accident involves the person or someone they employ</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Duties_Student" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicableDuties" targetRef="Task_StudentReport">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">student or schoolchild and an accident has occurred</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Duties_School" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicableDuties" targetRef="Task_ReportSchoolAccident">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">school, educational facility or university and work accident physically injured or killed a person with accident insurance</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Duties_Private" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicableDuties" targetRef="Task_PrivateImmediateReport">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">private insurance applies and an accident has occurred</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoReportingDuty" sourceRef="Gateway_ApplicableDuties" targetRef="Task_NoAdditionalReport"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_Join" sourceRef="Task_NotifyEmployer" targetRef="Gateway_JoinDuties"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Labour_Join" sourceRef="Task_ReportLabourInspectorate" targetRef="Gateway_JoinDuties"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Insurance_Join" sourceRef="Task_ReportAccidentInsurance" targetRef="Gateway_JoinDuties"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelfEmployed_Join" sourceRef="Task_ReportSelfEmployedAccident" targetRef="Gateway_JoinDuties"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Student_Join" sourceRef="Task_StudentReport" targetRef="Gateway_JoinDuties"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_School_Join" sourceRef="Task_ReportSchoolAccident" targetRef="Gateway_JoinDuties"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Private_ToFatalCheck" sourceRef="Task_PrivateImmediateReport" targetRef="Gateway_PrivateFatal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateFatal" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateFatal" targetRef="Task_PrivateFatalReport">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">fatality</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateNotFatal" sourceRef="Gateway_PrivateFatal" targetRef="Gateway_JoinDuties"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PrivateFatal_Join" sourceRef="Task_PrivateFatalReport" targetRef="Gateway_JoinDuties"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoDuty_Join" sourceRef="Task_NoAdditionalReport" targetRef="Gateway_JoinDuties"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_End" sourceRef="Gateway_JoinDuties" targetRef="EndEvent_Complete"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
